ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity (white/light-grey) pixels comprise approximately 90% of the visible surface, with low intensity (black) pixels restricted to a narrow peripheral boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. A continuous black band (width ~3-7% of lobe depth) follows the trailing edge. A distinct dark annular feature is located in the mid-upper quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 62 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 20% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entirety of the trailing edge, featuring peaks and valleys ranging from 5-20 pixels in amplitude relative to the primary curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by initial convexity extending from the median notch, transitioning into a concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread low-contrast circular elevations (pockmarks) distributed across the central white field. Dense, high-contrast, three-dimensional calcified clusters (barnacles) are localized on both the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three to four short, vertical, low-intensity pixel streaks originating near the median notch vertex and extending inferiorly.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; presence of a dark circular pigment mark on the left lobe and dark streaks inferior to the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'Type 1' pigmentation pattern characterized by a nearly uniform white ventral surface with a high-contrast black trailing edge margin.
